usageNotes: Permanently removes a webhook notification endpoint from the cluster by its config ID. The endpoint must not be referenced by any active notification matchers or rules — removing a webhook that is still in use by a matcher will leave those matchers in a broken state. Requires the Mapping.Modify privilege on /mapping/notifications.
destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the webhook endpoint configuration; any notification matchers still referencing this endpoint will silently fail to deliver alerts.
tips: Check active notification matchers with GET /cluster/notifications/matchers before deleting to avoid silent alert delivery failures.
The name must match a pve-configid — alphanumeric with hyphens/underscores, no spaces.
Returns null on success; a 4xx error indicates the endpoint does not exist or a permission failure.
